column1: # Each refused value reads inside its range as a float and above it as a double. A game binds the
# row to either, so the value is refused for every game, with the double codec's reason. A value at
# the top of its range reads the same both ways and is accepted.

column3: Defaults.ini: line 4: [Smoothing] LocalSmoothing=1.00000001 is not read (expected a number from 0.0 to 1.0), so the built-in 0.0 is used.
Defaults.ini: line 8: [Position] PositionLimitZ=10.0000001 is not read (expected a number from 0.0 to 10.0), so the built-in 0.4 is used.
